name: anytype-toolbox-skills
description: Agent Skills for Anytype setup, including a dedicated headless account for one LLM-sharing space, plus anyr and any-mcp workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Limit Anytype access with a dedicated headless account
interface.longDescription: Set up desktop access or a dedicated headless account invited only to an LLM-sharing space, then use anyr or any-mcp.
defaultPrompt: Use anytype-setup to connect a dedicated headless Anytype account only to an LLM-sharing space.
Use anyr to find and update an Anytype document.
Use any-mcp to organize content in Anytype.
